description: Find restaurants near a point or address and return an MCP App card for each. Default radius is a quarter mile.

address.description: Optional street address; resolved to lat/lng via Google Maps Geocoding API. Used only if latitude/longitude are not supplied.

history_n.description: How many recent inspections to include per restaurant. Default 3.

latitude.description: Center latitude in decimal degrees. Required if no address is provided.

longitude.description: Center longitude in decimal degrees. Required if no address is provided.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles. Defaults to 0.25 (a quarter mile).

name: find_nearby_restaurants
